title: Constant loss of signal/reconnection issues G5
symptom: The user reports periods of total loss of connection with the G5 transmitter, requiring phone restart and forgetting the device to reconnect. This can happen overnight, with intermittent signal pickup, and occurs even when the phone is nearby. The issue persists across transmitter changes and xDrip+ versions.
cause: The issue was caused by an updated Garmin Connect app interfering with Bluetooth connection.
fix: Uninstall the current Garmin Connect app and install an older version (Garmin Connect Mobile 4.1.5) from APKMirror, or perform a factory reset and uninstall Connect. Alternatively, use a 2017 version of Garmin Connect with a May 10th xDrip nightly version.
evidence_quote: The issue was an updated Garmin Connect app which was interfering with bluetooth conection. I did a factory reset and uninstalled Connect-the problem disappeared. Installing Connect again and the problem recurred.
